turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't decide how to study for my biology final, can you help?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait until I've listed everything before you jump in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is joining a study group that meets every evening in the library for about two hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's making flashcards on an app and going through them on the bus each morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is just rereading my notes and the textbook chapters over the weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is doing old practice exams my teacher posted online and checking the answers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alright, I'm finished. What's your opinion?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The practice exams are probably the strongest choice, since they show you exactly what you still don't know. Flashcards on the bus are a nice add-on for terms and definitions. Rereading notes feels productive, but it tends to stick the least.
